title: CSS Custom Properties (Variables) Runtime Theming Engine
topicCategory: 4. Styling Engines & CSS Architecture at Scale
subtopicTitle: CSS Custom Properties (Variables) Runtime Theming Engine
problemStatement:
Architecting a high-performance, dynamic runtime theming engine powered by CSS Custom Properties.

**Enterprise Importance**:
CSS variables enable zero-JS theme switching, inherited styling, and scoped component overrides without runtime CSS-in-JS re-render penalties.
interviewTrap: Over-relying on JS state to trigger CSS-in-JS style recalculations when native CSS custom properties can handle 100% of the style mutation.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: CSS variables cascade down the DOM tree. Defining `--theme-bg: white` on `:root` and changing it to `--theme-bg: black` on `.dark` instantly repaints the page without executing a single line of React code.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.

complexity.time: O(1) CSS variable resolution at paint time / zero JavaScript runtime overhead
complexity.space: O(1) bundle footprint per imported component
